title: Neurocomputing_(journal)
summary:
Neurocomputing is a peer-reviewed scientific journal covering research on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and neural computation. It was established in 1989 and is published by Elsevier. The editor-in-chief is Zidong Wang of Brunel University London.

Neurocomputing welcomes theoretical contributions aimed at winning further understanding of neural networks and learning systems, including architectures, learning methods, analysis of network dynamics, theories of learning, self-organization, biological neural network modelling, and interdisciplinary topics with artificial intelligence, cognitive science, fuzzy logic, genetic algorithms, machine learning, neurobiology and pattern recognition.

Neurocomputing reports on applications in different fields, including signal processing, speech processing, image processing, computer vision, control, robotics, optimization, scheduling, resource allocation and financial forecasting. The journal also has a Software Track that publishes Original Software Publications to disseminate useful software in the areas of neural networks and learning systems.

The journal has an impact factor of 5.5 and an h-index of 216, placing it in the Q1 quartile. The ISSN of Neurocomputing is 09252312 and 18728286.
